consumer_contract.number: Primitive sums explicit level.measure * population once. Adapter requires two explicit collinear spin sectors and every full unshifted Monkhorst-Pack slot once, with all original spin-local records represented. Measures are 1/Nk per primitive cell, never implicit spin two or XML IBZ fluctuation weights.
consumer_contract.neutral_charge: Uses existing SavedReference.nelec and original atom_names plus supplied existing decoded NCUPF.element/z_valence and original UPF byte bindings. Requires nelec exactly equal the atom-resolved neutral valence sum. Does not create a second XML parser or add fields to SavedReference.
consumer_contract.degeneracy: Exact equality of supplied finite energy labels only. Entire boundary block receives (target-number_below)/block_measure; no arbitrary half fill, band-index tie break or near-energy clustering. Returns common-multiplier interval and fractional-boundary log fugacity; no arbitrary gap chemical potential is selected.
consumer_contract.extension: Caller supplies complete canonical full-grid descriptors and source/frame/basis/extension identities, adopting XML-order unitary policy including inversion with no antiunitary spin swap. This is an explicit policy/producer-authority contract, not a claimed little-group invariance test.
consumer_contract.separation: Population specification needs no Gram or material raw D. Lazy instantiation requires matching original XML/WFC, full coverage and raw frame authority, every full PW row/source column, matching FactorFunctional frame/basis/dimension and agreement with recomputed raw Gram. Calls existing coefficients_from_orthonormal_populations and FactorPreparation without modifying raw frames.
consumer_contract.state_scope: Each returned FactorPreparation is one sector, explicitly not the neutral total. Initial complement is empty by decision authority, but full-row action/ordered-product complement is retained. No fixed-M alternative or prepared-dynamics integration was added.

oracles_written.independence: Enumerates six-mode Fock configurations and direct many-body Gibbs weights, solves a common chemical potential by independent bisection at beta 8,16,32, and compares marginals to the zero-T selector. Separately enumerates five-mode Fock probabilities and signed creation/annihilation bilinears for selected new preparation/Gram/population-correlation checks; it does not reuse the implementation filling function in the Gibbs comparator or reprove accepted factor algebra.
oracles_written.fixtures: Explicitly test-only energies [-2,0,0,3], spin labels [1,1,2,2], independent-mode multiplicities [1,2,1,2] and two-cell normalization; gapped target and non-half fractional exact-degenerate target; positive nonorthogonal rectangular raw frame; degenerate complex gauge; empty accessible complement and noncommuting generation Hamiltonian. Separate complete two-spin single-k analytic metadata exercises lazy instantiation, not actual SavedReference material decoding.
